{{Top|leg}}
'''Senatorial Observer''' was a title given to junior members of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] when they went on missions for the Senate. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] held this title when she went on a mission to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], officially to oversee the construction of the [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|skyhook]]. In reality, she was being held hostage to stop her adoptive father, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], from causing trouble in the Senate.
